विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

आग्नेय᳓म् अष्टा᳓कपालं नि᳓र्वपेन् मैत्रावरुणीं᳓ पयस्या᳙म्॥

The sweet one with the sweet, the sharp with the sharp, the bright with the bright,
the divine with the divine, the immortal with the immortal: I unite thee with Soma.
